title: Onboarding redesign review
text:
Final review of Priya Raman's onboarding redesign (7 screens down to 4).

Attendees: Priya Raman, Sam Okafor, Maya Chen, Wop testwell.

To decide:
- Progress bar (1 of 4, 2 of 4...)
- Can students skip the free-time grid and fill it in later?
- Notification permission request on screen 4 (fixes the Android 15 bug)

Before the meeting: add comments on the "Onboarding redesign" page in Notion.
